In applyStylesToWrappedText, when trimEnabled is true, the function skips whitespace in originalPlain (lines 236-243) to account for trimmed output. However, this whitespace skipping advances charIndex through originalPlain while the wrapped line has already consumed (or not consumed) those characters differently. Subsequently, charToSegment[charIndex] lookups (lines 248, 251) may index into the wrong segment because the character index no longer corresponds to the original text position that charToSegment was built from. The fallback ?? 0 masks the mismatch, causing styled segments to apply to wrong character ranges.
